name: m0saic-template-repo-starter-base
description: The compact twin of the m0saic template starter: the minimum set of files that load in Mosaic, plus one hello-world template. Fork it, rename it, build on it.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node tools/copy-assets.mjs && node dist/gen-template-manifest.js
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run lint && npm test && npm run test:contract && npm run check:deps

//dependencies: The @m0saic/* substrate is not on npm yet — it currently ships only
bundled inside the `m0saic` CLI package. Until it publishes, AUTHOR MODE
(build / test / lint) requires a checkout of the m0saic monorepo as a
SIBLING directory (../m0saic) so these file: links resolve.
USING the repo needs no install at all: dist/ is committed, so the app
(Templates -> Add source) and the CLI (--template-repo) load it as-is,
and the host resolves @m0saic/* from its own module tree at load time.
